content: Hardware KVM switch complaints (100-500ms input lag, missed/doubled characters, HDMI-handshake blackouts) are the categorical argument for why 'switch delay/dwell time' is unwanted — any perceptible latency between intent and input landing reads as a defect, corroborating ilhop's own removal of a 700ms dwell as 'laggy.' No direct evidence found of software KVM tools using deliberate dwell/delay as a feature — none of Synergy/Barrier/input-leap/Flow/Universal Control add artificial delay; all favor instant edge-triggering or single-keypress hotkeys.
